paragraphs.text:
Norman exerts his usual steadying influence, and together you 
shake off the worst effects of the fight. You fetch out the first 
aid kit and then turn your attention to the dead creature.

You  may  attempt  a  First  Aid  roll  to  restore  1D3  hit  points  to 
yourself and Norman (if you lost that many). Afterward, go to 379.
